page.notes: Right margin notes are three-line marginal glosses; the lines "be-num Dei fi-men" are uncertain ("benum" and "fi-men" partly read, the word "semen" is likely but not clearly legible). The chapter title "Quod Evangelicam..." is italic in print. The head "CAP. VII." is printed in spaced capitals with a period.
